improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline personalizes the product by naming Gideon while clearly stating its role as an AI partner for trade and business. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no payment commitment. This builds trust and encourages immediate engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, with flexible monthly or annual billing options—annual plans save you 30 percent. Your membership unlocks unlimited searches, voice chat, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model: what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating exact pricing, and reinforcing the value unlocked by membership, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust—key factors in converting trial users to paying members.
